address.lineWithUnit: 86 Old King's Highway South Unit 2nd Floor

remarks: Charming, spacious, recently-freshened upper apartment in two-family home. New kitchen cabinets and counters to installed in March. Porch overlooking front yard. Convenient walk to downtown Darien and train. Large front and back yards. 1-car detached garage, and plenty of room for off-street parking. Available immediately.   Electricity, heat, water, and trash removal included in the rent, as well as lawn care. Tenants pay for gas for stove, cable/internet, and snow removal. 500 pet fee if approved. Rental application and credit check. First month's rent and two months' security.
